tasks.short: Keep current through literature, colleagues and conferences.

steps.what: Find actual current criminal justice and law enforcement literature relevant to teaching
inputs: actual publication and conference source records

steps.what: Read current literature and assess actual developments and limitations
Talk with colleagues about actual criminal justice developments
Participate in actual professional conferences to learn about field developments
outputs: actual conference participation and professional learning

tasks.design: Configure native topic/source filters in the research library {OTHER} and source links in {DOCS}. The teacher checks relevance, reads original work and retains all collegial discussion and conference participation.
tasks.previous_blocker: Finding relevant professional sources can repeat navigation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native topic and publication filters can shorten discovery.
tasks.still_hard: Understanding evidence, practice changes and implications requires reading and professional interaction.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher distinguishes a useful development from an unsupported claim or a different jurisdiction's practice.
tasks.altitude: Less discovery navigation; professional learning stays intact.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native research-library filters can support source discovery; they do not replace reading, collegial discussion or conference learning.

assumptions: Actual publication/conference owners supply existing metadata; teacher sets actual topics and checks relevance in s1. No free summary or automatic understanding is assumed.
Literature, colleagues and conferences are a provisional task mix, not mandatory events per update or a measured baseline. Reading, discussion and participation remain fully retained.

No record write, report, registration transaction or digital send is required by the stated learning task; actual additional duties must be decomposed separately. Native filters first; existing filtered access earns zero saving.
unknowns: How much discovery is repeated navigation?
research_questions: Can native filters reduce discovery while preserving original-source reading?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 10*0.50 discovery navigation = 5; minus 0.5 upkeep = 4.5. Half eligible gives 2.5 minus 0.5 = 2. Learning and interaction remain retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Maintain attendance, grades and required student records.

steps.what: Capture and verify actual attendance, assessed grades and required student record sources
outputs: checked actual student record source fields

steps.what: Transfer actual existing grades and attendance into draft registry fields
inputs: checked actual student record source fields

steps.what: Maintain student attendance records, grades and other required records in registry {OTHER}
Check final student records against actual sources and required completeness
inputs: checked actual student record source fields

steps.what: Commit the checked final actual student records
outputs: committed actual attendance, grades and student records

tasks.design: Configure native exact attendance/grade transfer from {LMS} into draft fields in the student registry {OTHER}, followed by native required-field entry. The teacher captures actual primary inputs, checks complete final records and commits them separately.
tasks.previous_blocker: Already assessed grades and actual attendance may be retyped into required records.
tasks.enabler_now: Supported exact-field mappings can remove duplicate transfer and repeated references.
tasks.still_hard: Correct identity, actual results and required completeness need full teacher checks.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher knows whether a source result is final and belongs to the actual student.
tasks.altitude: Less duplicate registry entry; assessment decisions stay human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: supported exact grade/attendance imports can reduce duplicate registry entry where actual identifiers and result states match; local interface support remains unverified.

assumptions: Actual attendance owner/teacher supplies student, course, event/assessment identifier, date, value and result status; primary capture and source checking remain in s1. Missing/ambiguous fields and new required notes stay manual in retained s3.

S2 transfers existing values into a draft; it does not grade work or publish results. S3 cuts repeated identifiers and standard fields, not actual new observation capture. All final checks remain retained.
Shares are provisional, not measured baselines. Native supported imports first; existing automatic transfer earns zero saving. Routine commit is one percent and uses the existing final check.
Any separate student-facing release is its own actual final-version-gated action with no saving claimed here. Shared record capture is counted once across teaching tasks.
unknowns: Which record values are entered twice?
Is a supported draft import available?
research_questions: Does native transfer reduce actual copying after complete identity and result checks?

incremental.description: Maintain actual student/course/event mappings and registry fields.

approvals.approved_version: s4 checked final actual student records and exact student/course destinations; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 25 duplicate transfer + 25*0.40 repeated fields = 35; minus 2 upkeep = 33. Half eligible gives 17.5 minus 2 = 15.5. Primary capture, actual grade decisions, final checks and commit stay retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Retrieve and verify actual course goals, schedules and selected source materials
Choose actual syllabus requirements, homework objectives and handout explanations
inputs: actual student needs and teaching approach
outputs: actual chosen course material content and learning intent

steps.what: Prepare course materials including syllabi, homework assignments and handouts
inputs: actual chosen course material content and learning intent
outputs: draft actual syllabus, assignment or handout

loop.purpose: Draft actual course materials from teacher choices
loop.input: Actual selected content, learning intent and checked sources
loop.check: Teacher checks subject meaning, learning intent, unsupported legal claims and omitted task requirements
loop.stop: Missing actual content choice or two failed revisions returns writing to manual work
loop.why_not_simpler: Native syllabus fields and reusable resource blocks first; assignment and handout explanations vary

steps.what: Check final course materials for scientific, practical and teaching accuracy
inputs: draft actual syllabus, assignment or handout
actual chosen course material content and learning intent
outputs: checked final actual course materials and course destination

steps.what: Save the checked final actual course materials
inputs: checked final actual course materials and course destination

steps.what: Publish the checked final course materials to the actual course in {LMS}
inputs: checked final actual course materials and course destination

tasks.design: Configure native course/source links and fixed syllabus fields in {LMS}, then use a bounded explanation draft in {DOCS}. The teacher selects content, checks complete final materials and separately saves and publishes the exact course version.
tasks.previous_blocker: Materials preparation can repeat source navigation and writing after content choices.
tasks.enabler_now: Native resource reuse and bounded drafting can reduce preparation.
tasks.still_hard: Accurate subject treatment and suitable learning tasks require teacher judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher recognises an explanation that is fluent but misleading about criminal justice practice.
tasks.altitude: Less materials drafting; teaching content decisions stay human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native course fields and bounded materials drafting can reduce navigation and first-draft prose; they do not establish subject accuracy or suitable learning intent.

assumptions: Actual approved course and source owners supply goals, schedule and original materials. Teacher verifies sources in s1, chooses actual content in s2 and captures/checks explanation meaning within retained s3; missing content remains manual.

Syllabi, assignments and handouts are a provisional mix, not three mandatory outputs each time. Shares are not measured baselines; count only actual new/revised materials, with reused preparation counted once.
Native fields/resource blocks first; already automated assembly earns zero saving. Full final teaching/subject review remains retained.
Save and publication each retain one percent, gated on exact final materials and destination. No extra self-approval time is added. Curriculum decisions are separately counted under task 6200.
unknowns: How much new/revised prose is repetitive?
Which native resource blocks are already used?
research_questions: Does drafting reduce writing after full subject and learning-intent review?

already_counted.description: Capture and correct course-material meaning within s3.

incremental.description: Maintain actual course/source links and materials drafting checks.

approvals.approved_version: s4 checked final actual course materials and exact internal document destination; edits require recheck
s4 checked final actual course materials and exact course/student destination; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 20*0.40 source navigation + 24*0.40 prose = 17.6; minus 1.5 upkeep = 16.1. Half eligible gives 8.8 minus 1.5 = 7.3. Content choices, final checks, save and publication remain retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Plan, evaluate and revise curricula and instruction.

steps.what: Retrieve and verify actual curriculum, course evidence and teaching-method feedback
inputs: actual current curriculum and course versions
actual student work and course feedback
actual institutional goals and revision authority

steps.what: Evaluate curricula, course content, materials and methods against actual evidence
outputs: actual teaching evaluation findings and limitations

steps.what: Plan and choose actual curriculum, content, material and instructional-method revisions
inputs: actual teaching evaluation findings and limitations
actual institutional goals and revision authority

steps.what: Write actual revised curriculum and course-method text from chosen changes
inputs: actual current curriculum and course versions

loop.purpose: Draft revised text from actual teacher decisions
loop.input: Current versions and actual chosen authorised revisions
loop.check: Teacher checks pedagogical meaning, omitted changes, unsupported outcomes and fidelity to actual revision choices
loop.stop: Missing actual chosen change or two failed revisions returns text revision to manual work
loop.why_not_simpler: Native tracked-change fields and fixed course headings first; revised explanations vary

steps.what: Check exact final teaching revisions against chosen changes and actual revision authority
outputs: checked final actual authorised teaching revisions

steps.what: Commit the checked final authorised curriculum and course-method revisions
inputs: checked final actual authorised teaching revisions

tasks.design: Configure native evidence/version links in {LMS} and {DOCS}, then use bounded tracked-text drafting after actual revision decisions. The teacher evaluates teaching, chooses changes within existing authority, checks exact final revisions and commits them.
tasks.previous_blocker: Curriculum work can repeat evidence navigation and text revision after teaching decisions.
tasks.enabler_now: Native evidence links and bounded tracked revision can reduce preparation and prose editing.
tasks.still_hard: Evaluating learning and deciding better instruction require scholarly and teaching judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher distinguishes a genuine curriculum problem from an incomplete or misleading feedback signal.
tasks.altitude: Less evidence navigation and revision prose; teaching judgement stays human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native evidence/version links and bounded tracked-text drafting can support curriculum revision; they do not determine educational effectiveness or confer revision authority.

assumptions: Actual course owners supply current versions and collected feedback/student work; teacher verifies source relevance in s1, evaluates evidence in s2 and chooses actual revisions in s3. Missing evidence or authorisation remains manual and no free outcomes data is assumed.
Only source navigation and prose after actual choices lose time. Scientific/educational interpretation and the complete final change check stay retained.

Commit covers changes within the teacher's actual existing authority; broader curriculum decisions require actual curriculum-owner approval after the final proposed version exists, with no avoided approval labour claimed. No new decision rights are assumed.

Shares are provisional, not measured baselines. Native links/track changes first; existing automatic assembly earns zero saving. Routine commit retains one percent and uses the existing final check. Actual material production under 6198 is counted once rather than repeated here.
unknowns: Which evidence navigation is actually repeated?
Which revisions are within this teacher's authority?
research_questions: Does tracked drafting reduce prose revision after complete pedagogical and authority checks?
